DSH XP Luna
Theme for DeepSeek Harness · DeepSeek Harness 主题
Windows XP Luna, rebuilt as a skin.
把 W
indows XP 的 Luna 桌面，重新做回一套皮肤。
English · 简体中文
## English
A DeepSeek Harness theme that puts the Windows XP Luna desktop back on screen: a blue taskbar column
on the left, and the conversation inside a floating XP window with a glass body and a Luna titlebar
. The wallpaper is **not bundled** — import your own image from the theme's Settings page, or start
from the built-in gradient.
It is not a pixel-perfect recreation — the native window frame and the system taskbar live outside t
he page — but it keeps what makes Luna recognisable: the beige work surface, square corners, hard sh
adows, opaque menus, pale-yellow tooltips, and three caption buttons in the top-right corner.
### ✨ Features
| | Feature | Notes |
| 🖼 | **Host-stored wallpaper** | Import the Microsoft 4K nostalgic wallpaper, Bliss.jpg, or any JPG

/PNG/WebP from **Settings → XP Luna theme**; stored on this machine, never committed |
| 🔵 | **Luna
taskbar sidebar** | Left column as a blue gradient, with text, icons and borders turned white inside

it |
| 🧊 | **Glass window** | The conversation, the Plugins page and the automation tasks page are
translucent beige with a light backdrop blur (`0.75` / `4px`, both tunable); other management pages

stay opaque so their lists stay readable |
| 🪟 | **Luna titlebars** | The conversation header gets t
he glossy gradient and three XP-style caption buttons, close colour on the far-right control; the Pl

ugins page header gets the same full-width band |
| 🖱 | **XP command buttons** | The automation task
s page's “New” button and the Plugins toolbar use the beveled Luna surface instead of flat host fill

s |
| 🎨 | **141 token overrides** | Beige surfaces, square corners, hard shadows, opaque menus, pale

-yellow tooltips, wider scrollbars |
| 🌗 | **Light mode only** | Dark mode keeps the built-in palett

e; the skin removes itself when you switch |
| 🪶 | **No bundled dependencies** | Theme tokens plus o
ne stylesheet; React comes from the host module table; the settings live on an official Settings pag
stylesheet; React comes from the host module table; the settings live on an official Settings page |
### 📸 Screenshots
| Main window | Settings page |
> The screenshots use the built-in CSS gradient, without an imported wallpaper.
### 📦 Install
**Desktop app (recommended)** — open **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste the repository address below, a
nd confirm. The app installs into its own profile.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Plugin Market / npm** — the theme is published as `dsh-xp-luna`; install it from **Plugins → Plugi
n Market → Themes**, or:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Desktop, from the command line (GitHub)** — quit the app completely first: the `desktop` profile b
elongs to the app, and the app rewrites it on exit. `--profile` must come before the pnpm arguments.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Web / other profiles** — use the profile you actually boot:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Local checkout (development)** — in **Add plugin**, paste the absolute path of this directory inst
ead. The committed `client.js` already contains the built bundle, so a fresh clone needs no build st
ep; after editing `src/client.js`, run `node scripts/build.mjs`.
### 🖼 Wallpaper
This repository ships **no wallpaper files**. Open **Settings → XP Luna theme** to import one; the p
lugin starts on a neutral XP-coloured gradient until then.
The page has two parts:
- **Desktop wallpaper** — preview, **Import a local image** (JPG, JPEG, PNG or WebP), **Remove wallp
aper**, and the official download link. The original file is uploaded to the local Host (never to th
e internet) and stored in `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-xp-luna-data/`, outside the repository. It survives app re
starts and the Web UI's changing port. **Removing it deletes that stored file** and restores the gra

Web UI's changing port. **Removing it deletes that stored file** and restores the gradient.
[该节后续省略]
### 🎛 Configuration
Everything else lives in `src/client.js`; rebuild with `node scripts/build.mjs` after a change.
| What | Where | Default |

### ⚠️ Known limitations
- **Not a pixel-perfect recreation.** The native window frame, the system taskbar and the Start menu
are outside the page. There is no page-side IPC for minimise/maximise/close either, so the caption

buttons are visual only.
- The sidebar acts as the “taskbar” and the conversation header as the “tit

lebar”; that is a reinterpretation of the layout, not a native XP structure.
- On a blank Session th
e header does not render its utility row, so the caption buttons disappear until a conversation exis

ts.
- The glass covers the conversation, the Plugins page and the automation tasks page; other manag
ement pages (Settings, ...) keep an opaque work surface. The composer seat's beige fade is cleared s
o the glass shows through; the composer card, compaction and disclosure headers keep their own surfa

ces.
- **No wallpaper ships with the plugin.** Without an import, the desktop uses the gradient fall
back; wallpapers are user-provided and must comply with their own copyright terms. Small images are

stretched by `background-size: cover`; the settings page warns under 1920 px wide.
- The Host half r
egisters the wallpaper/settings routes at startup; after upgrading the plugin, restart the desktop a

pp once.
- **Plugin UIs in their own frame on dark Linux desktops.** Plugin pages such as billion-co
ntext are framed by the host (`?embed=1`), and the theme's CSS cannot style controls inside that fra
me. With KDE BreezeDark or GNOME `prefer-dark`, the frame follows the OS dark palette while Harness
itself stays light, so a native `<select>` can end up with light text on a light popup (for example
billion-context's version picker). Workaround: switch the desktop to a light colour scheme, or open
the plugin's Web UI in a browser tab. A real fix has to come from the plugin or the host, not from t

he theme.
- **Fully restart after an update.** The client bundle is read when Harness starts; a page
refresh does not load new CSS, and the beige glass can look wrong until the app is reopened.
